description_en: Starts an application in a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) or Serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster
description_zh: 启动容器服务K8s或Serverless K8s集群中的应用
name: StartK8sApplication

parameters.help_en: The number of application instances to start
parameters.name: replicas

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the change process, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 1800. Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh: 变更流程超时时间，单位秒，取值范围1~1800秒，不填默认值为600秒
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to obtain the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过调用ListApplication接口来获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id
